title: Shove-it · body/board dual clock → recapture
transferable_principle: A task object may carry an orientation clock that diverges from the body's root/support clock during airborne separation. Landing is not only vertical descent; it is a synchronization event where body trajectory, object orientation, foot/object contact, and ground support must converge before stable ride-away.
